name: fable-workflow
description: A configurable, data-model-agnostic workflow engine for Fable: an append-only event log, state machines defined entirely in config (states, guarded multi-exit transitions, role and data gates), and materialized projections (time metrics + eligibility) so the agency questions are reads. Guards are structured condition trees over Manyfest addresses; the engine never imports a consumer's schema.
author: steven velozo <steven@velozo.com>
